mandala-art coreSummary states the word 'mandala' is first documented in the Rig Veda (c. 1500-1200 BCE) naming the text's ten books, 'not a drawing,' while the earliest pictorial mandalas survive only from 8th-9th century CE Tibetan sketches -- a gap the article itself says is 'closer to two thousand years than to one.' Body also notes 'this gets flattened in a lot of general-audience writing about mandalas,' confirming the bridge sentence's claim that the word/concept predates the images by roughly two millennia and popular understanding blurs the two.
